Definition: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go, walk, come; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go, walk, come, depart, proceed, move, go away; 1a2) to die, live, manner of life (fig.); 1b) (Hiphil) to lead, bring, lead away, carry, cause to walk
